Title: Freak Drive while going to torpor

Messages.Author: markeeuu
Messages.Body:
I can't find a rule for this, let's say I lock to bleed and use a card that sends my vampire to torpor (i.e Daring the Dawn), can I still use Freak Drive since it's a modifier?

The sequence of events in my view go like this:
Lock -> Bleed -> Play Daring the Dawn -> Action Resolution (which is bleed happens and vampire goes to torpor) -> Freak Drive

In my opinion, I can do it because A) Freak doesn't restrict it and B ) Rules say that torpor vampire can play modifiers on their own actions (like stealth cards)

Thoughts?

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: Yes, you can play Freak Drive after having gone to torpor during your own action.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Correct.

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Action modifiers are by default playable by minions in torpor, the ones that aren't specify that they require a 'ready' minion, which is mainly the ones played by someone other than the acting vampire.
